nodes.label: Incremental --update Flow
nodes.rationale: detect_incremental yields the changed subset into files and the full corpus into all_files. If every changed file is code, semantic extraction is skipped entirely (no LLM, no subagents); if any doc/paper/image changed the full pipeline runs, and changed video must be transcribed and rewritten into files['document'] first or raw media paths reach subagents as unreadable input.

nodes.label: build_merge Replace-on-Re-extract
nodes.rationale: build_merge reads graph.json directly without a NetworkX round-trip so edge direction is preserved. prune_sources is only for genuinely deleted files — changed files are reconciled by replace-on-re-extract, and adding them to prune would delete the freshly extracted content. root= must be passed or nothing is pruned and stale nodes accumulate every update; directed= must be passed or a --directed update silently rebuilds undirected and collapses reciprocal edges.

nodes.label: --cluster-only Flow
nodes.rationale: Self-contained: re-clusters, names communities, and regenerates the report, graph.json, and graph.html from the existing graph. Steps 5-9 must NOT be re-run because they read intermediate files that the prior build's cleanup already deleted, raising FileNotFoundError.

edges.source_location: populate .graphify_detect.json so Step 3B0 cache check sees only what changed
